articles.summary: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Oct. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - B2Gold Corp. (TSX: BTO, NYSE AMERICAN: BTG, NSX: B2G) (B2Gold or the Company) will release its third quarter 2026 financial and operational results after the North American markets close on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. B2Gold executives will host a conference call to discuss the results on Thursday, November 5, 2026, at 9:00 am PCT / 11:00 am ET. To participate in the live call, please use one of the following methods: Toll-free in U.S. and Canada: +1 (833) 821-2803 International: +1 (647) 846-2419 Webcast: access link The conference call will be available for playback for two weeks by dialing toll-free in the U.S. and Canada: +1 (855) 669-9658, replay access code 9332075. All other callers: +1 (412) 317-0088, replay access code 9332075. About B2Gold B2Gold is a responsible international gold producer headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
